api_changes.detail: The Veo guide's samples call client.models.generate_videos and POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/{id}:predictLongRunning with a Veo model id. The warning on that page says to migrate to gemini-omni-1.2-flash or the GA models on the Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform. No generate_videos sample for gemini-omni-1.2-flash was found on that page, so this page does not show a model-id swap.

migration_checklist: Read the shutdown date for veo-3.1-generate-001 on the linked official page.
Re-check price, context, and parameters on the provider pages linked here.
Ship the change before the published shutdown date.
